title: Popular but Wrong: Understanding and Mitigating LLM Overconfidence through Knowledge Popularity
abstract: arXiv:2505.17537v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce incorrect answers with high confidence, yet the factors associated with such overconfidence remain insufficiently understood. We study this problem through the lens of knowledge popularity. Using entity-centric factual QA derived from Wikidata triplets, we characterize popularity through question entity popularity, answer popularity, and question-answer co-occurrence. We find two consistent patterns. First, hallucinated answers are far from random: compared with ground-truth answers, they tend to be more popular or more frequently associated with the question entity. Second, confidence is strongly tied to the popularity of generated answers: even among incorrect predictions, more popular answers or those with higher question-answer co-occurrence receive higher confidence. translated_title: 流行但错误：通过知识流行度理解与缓解大语言模型的过度自信
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）经常以高置信度给出错误答案，然而与这种过度自信相关的因素仍未被充分理解。我们从知识流行度的视角研究这一问题。基于从Wikidata三元组派生的以实体为中心的事实性问答数据，我们通过问题实体流行度、答案流行度以及问题-答案共现程度来刻画流行度。我们发现了两个一致的模式。第一，幻觉答案远非随机产生：与真实答案相比，幻觉答案往往更流行，或与问题实体的关联更频繁。第二，置信度与生成答案的流行度密切相关：即使在错误的预测中，更流行的答案或具有更高问题-答案共现度的答案也会获得更高的置信度。这些发现共同表明，“流行但错误”的备选答案可能是导致过度自信的因素之一。我们进一步表明（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文发现大语言模型的过度自信与知识流行度密切相关——幻觉答案往往比真实答案更“流行”，且模型对更流行的错误答案给出更高置信度，表明“流行但错误”的答案是导致LLM过度自信的重要原因。
en_tdlr: LLM overconfidence is strongly tied to knowledge popularity: hallucinated answers tend to be more popular than ground-truth ones, and even incorrect answers that are more popular or co-occur more with the question entity receive higher confidence, suggesting that "popular but wrong" alternatives drive LLM overconfidence.
